name: just
description: Find a name and a domain for your business, and put your website online. Just Domain checks a name against trademark registers, which domain names are available, what each costs to register and renew, and links to register one on justdomain.ai; no account is needed to search. Just Publish puts a static site live at a public link, edits it later and helps connect your domain; you sign in once. Nothing is bought in the chat: you register and pay on justdomain.ai.
